research_question: Does the frozen MG correction mechanism improve future-state prediction compared with the existing base prediction when both are evaluated against the same independently observed outcome?
ground_truth_status: No repository source is verified as independently observed ground truth for this evaluation. The 15-row experiences.json corpus is documented as synthetic; the default transition service also loads synthetic_experiences.json. Other actual_state-labelled data lacks row-level provenance and is described as synthetic or is populated by caller-supplied/test values.

evaluation_population.required_population: Prospectively collected or provenance-verified real completed single-action episodes with paired pre-action state/predictions and independently measured post-action state.
evaluation_population.note: Repeated scripted scenarios are not independent observed outcomes or an evaluation population.

methodology_status: PROPOSED_NOT_FROZEN; blocked pending approved target population, measurement horizon/instrument, minimum meaningful effect, and a priori power/sample-size plan.
blocking_issues: No independently observed, provenance-verified action-linked post-state cohort was found.
experiences.json is explicitly documented as synthetic and is used by TransitionEngine to generate base predictions.
ExperienceService loads synthetic_experiences.json by default; matching these records as evaluation labels would contaminate the baseline.
17.15 has four repeated scripted input signatures, with seed and experience_id null on all events; 2,400 is not the independent outcome sample size.
17.15 lacks per-event context, event timestamps, and actual_state_after; fixed prediction horizon and measurement source are unspecified.
experience_dataset.json actual_state values have no row-level provenance/user identity and the logger accepts caller-supplied values; test code supplies hard-coded examples.
The prior proposal to use the legacy prediction as a synthetic fallback actual outcome is circular and invalid; it must not be implemented.
State/action/context schemas and measurable target dimensions need to be fixed before choosing an error metric and evaluating outcomes.

protocol_proposal.evaluation_unit: One unique, verified, completed real action episode with both predictions recorded before outcome observation.
protocol_proposal.ground_truth_definition: Independently measured post-action state for the same episode, with source, measurement method, timestamp, state schema/version, and fixed pre-registered follow-up horizon.
protocol_proposal.matching_rules: Pair base and MG forecasts directly by unique observed episode ID. Do not synthesize outcomes, nearest-neighbor match to training data, reuse a target across rows, or include any evaluation episode in model fitting/calibration.
protocol_proposal.primary_error_metric: Per-event MAE over the same predeclared valid skill dimensions and common scale; missing dimensions are not defaulted to zero.
protocol_proposal.comparison_metric: delta = MAE_MG - MAE_base, computed within each same outcome episode.
protocol_proposal.statistical_test: Paired, cluster-aware sign-flip/permutation test with user-level (and where needed time-block) bootstrap confidence intervals; finalize against observed independence structure before registration.
protocol_proposal.effect_size: Mean paired delta and 95% cluster-aware CI; paired standardized d_z with CI as descriptive context.
protocol_proposal.minimum_evidence_for_improvement: Pre-register delta_min and obtain adequate a priori power (at least 80% for delta_min); improvement only if the 95% CI upper bound is below -delta_min and the primary test meets alpha.
protocol_proposal.no_meaningful_difference: Equivalence test supports the full pre-registered interval [-delta_min, +delta_min]; nonsignificance alone is insufficient.
protocol_proposal.degradation: 95% CI lower bound is above +delta_min and the primary test meets alpha.
protocol_proposal.inconclusive: All other cases, including insufficient clusters, failed provenance, or confidence intervals crossing decision boundaries.
protocol_proposal.freeze_state: Draft only; freeze after population, outcome horizon/instrument, delta_min and power plan are approved, before outcome values are examined.

recommended_next_step: Obtain or prospectively collect a provenance-verified independent action-outcome cohort. Approve and freeze the evaluation protocol (including horizon, delta_min, and power plan) before any outcome comparison. Do not implement or run effectiveness analysis on current repository data.
